********************************************************************************** ********************************************************************************** *******Slave1_createdataset.do ********************************************************************************** ********************************************************************************** *******Identify individuals************************************************************ ********************************************************************************** *Select individuals of age range 15-21 in 1990 use "D:\GeoSweden\GeoSweden Stata\Alla register\Basdata\IBF_IndData1990_2014.dta", clear gen age1990 = 1990-FoddAr keep if age1990 >= 15 & age1990 <= 21 rename Kon sex keep IBFLopNr IBFLopNrMor IBFLopNrFar sex FoddAr *Add info on FamID and FamID of parents to identfy when the child leaves the parental home foreach i of numlist 1990 1991 1992 1993 1994 1995 1996 1997 1998 1999 2000{ merge 1:1 IBFLopNr using "D:\GeoSweden\GeoSweden Stata\Alla register\Basdata\ibf_bef`i'.dta", keepusing(FamLopNr) drop if _merge == 2 drop _merge rename FamLopNr FamLopNr`i' } foreach i of numlist 2001 2003 2004 2005 2006 2007 2008 2009 2010{ merge 1:1 IBFLopNr using "D:\GeoSweden\GeoSweden Stata\Alla register\Basdata\ibf_bef`i'.dta", keepusing(FamLopNr) drop if _merge == 2 drop _merge rename FamLopNr FamLopNr`i' } rename IBFLopNr IBFLopNr_child rename IBFLopNrMor IBFLopNr foreach i of numlist 1990 1991 1992 1993 1994 1995 1996 1997 1998 1999 2000 { merge m:1 IBFLopNr using "D:\GeoSweden\GeoSweden Stata\Alla register\Basdata\ibf_bef`i'.dta", keepusing(FamLopNr) drop if _merge == 2 drop _merge rename FamLopNr FamLopNrMor`i'

} rename IBFLopNr IBFLopNrMor rename IBFLopNrFar IBFLopNr foreach i of numlist 1990 1991 1992 1993 1994 1995 1996 1997 1998 1999 2000 { merge m:1 IBFLopNr using "D:\GeoSweden\GeoSweden Stata\Alla register\Basdata\ibf_bef`i'.dta", keepusing(FamLopNr) drop if _merge == 2 drop _merge rename FamLopNr FamLopNrFar`i' } rename IBFLopNr IBFLopNrFar rename IBFLopNr_child IBFLopNr *live home in 1990 - keep only the ones who do gen livewpar90 = 1 if FamLopNr1990 == FamLopNrMor1990 | FamLopNr1990 == FamLopNrFar1990 keep if livewpar90 == 1 drop livewpar90 *year of leaving parental home - keep only those who move out between 1991 and 1997 gen yrleavehome = . replace yrleavehome = 1991 if FamLopNr1990 == FamLopNrMor1990 | FamLopNr1990 == FamLopNr1990_far & FamLopNr1990 != . replace yrleavehome = 1992 if FamLopNr1991 == FamLopNrMor1991 | FamLopNr1991 == FamLopNr1991_far & FamLopNr1991 != . replace yrleavehome = 1993 if FamLopNr1992 == FamLopNrMor1992 | FamLopNr1992 == FamLopNr1992_far & FamLopNr1992 != . replace yrleavehome = 1994 if FamLopNr1993 == FamLopNrMor1993 | FamLopNr1993 == FamLopNr1993_far & FamLopNr1993 != . replace yrleavehome = 1995 if FamLopNr1994 == FamLopNrMor1994 | FamLopNr1994 == FamLopNr1994_far & FamLopNr1994 != . replace yrleavehome = 1996 if FamLopNr1995 == FamLopNrMor1995 | FamLopNr1995 == FamLopNr1995_far & FamLopNr1995 != . replace yrleavehome = 1997 if FamLopNr1996 == FamLopNrMor1996 | FamLopNr1996 == FamLopNr1996_far & FamLopNr1996 != . replace yrleavehome = 1998 if FamLopNr1997 == FamLopNrMor1997 | FamLopNr1997 == FamLopNr1997_far & FamLopNr1997 != . replace yrleavehome = . if yrleavehome == 1998 & FamLopNr1997 == . replace yrleavehome = . if FamLopNr1990 == . & FamLopNr1991 == . & FamLopNr1992 == . & FamLopNr1993 == . & FamLopNr1994 == . & FamLopNr1995 == . & FamLopNr1996 == . & FamLopNr1997 == . label variable yrleavehome "first year living away from parents" keep if yrleavehome >= 1991 & yrleavehome <= 1997 gen yrleave_14 = yrleavehome+13 label variable ylrleave_14 "year 14 years after having left parental home" gen whichparent = 1 if FamLopNr1990 == FamLopNrMor1990 replace whichparent = 2 if FamLopNr1990 == FamLopNrFar1990 replace whichparent = 3 if FamLopNr1990 == FamLopNrMor1990 & FamLopNr1990 == FamLopNrFar1990

label variable whichparent "which parent ego lives with before move" label define whichlabs 1 "mother" 2 "father" 3 "both" label values whichparent whichlabs drop FamLopNr# FamLopNrMor# FamLopNrFar# //* Save separate files for girls and boy to create same-sex sibling pairs save "$path\girls.dta" keep if sex == 1 save "$path\boys.dta" use "$path\girls.dta" keep if sex == 2 save "$path\girls.dta", replace ********************************************************************************** ******Create siblings*************************************************** ********************************************************************************** ******Female sibling pairs********************************************************** ********************************************************************************** use "$path\girls.dta", clear bysort IBFLopNrMor IBFLopNrFar: gen sib_n = _n drop if sib_n < 2 reshape wide IBFLopNr sex FoddAr yrleavehome yrleave_14 whichparent, i(IBFLopNrMor IBFLopNrFar) j(sib_n) gen sibID = _n reshape long sibID IBFLopNr sex FoddAr yrleavehome yrleave_14 whichparent sib_n, i(IBFLopNrMor IBFLopNrFar) j(sibID_within) drop if IBFLopNr == . *Keep siblings in right age range sort sibID FoddAr gen age_diff =(FoddAr - FoddAr[_n+1] if sibID == sibID[_n+1]) replace age_diff = abs(age_diff) bysort sibID: egen age_diff_small = min(age_diff) keep if age_diff_small <=3 * Keep families where at least one child leaves home between 1991 and 1993 gen home91_93 = 1 if yrleavehome >=1991 & yrleavehome <= 1993 bysort sibID: egen sibhome91_93 = count(home91_93) keep if sibhome91_93 >= 1 *Keep only siblings who leave home min 4 years apart sort sibID yrleavehome gen leave_diff =(yrleavehome - yrleavehome[_n+1] if sibID == sibID[_n+1])

replace leave_diff = abs(leave_diff) bysort sibID: egen leave_diff_small = min(leave_diff) keep if leave_diff_small <=4 *Keep only pair closest in age gen sibpair = 1 if age_diff == age_diff_small replace sibpair = 1 if age_diff[_n-1] == age_diff_small[_n-1] keep if sibpair == 1 *keep only siblings living with same parent bysort sibID: gen samepar = 1 if whichparent == whichparent[_n+1] replace samepar = 1 if whichparent == whichparent[_n-1] & sibID == sibID[_n-1] *Drop created variables drop sibID_within sib_n age_diff age_diff_small home91_93 sibhome91_93 leave_diff leave_diff_small sibpair samepar *generate sibID different from males(avoid replicas) replace sibID = 2000000+sibID *gen sibling sex variable gen sib_sex == 2 label define sib_sex_label 1 "male siblings" 2 "female siblings" label values sib_sex sib_sex_label save "$path\girls.dta", replace ********************************************************************************** ******Male sibling pairs****************************************************************************** ********************************************************************************** use "$path\boys.dta", clear bysort IBFLopNrMor IBFLopNrFar: gen sib_n = _n drop if sib_n < 2 reshape wide IBFLopNr sex FoddAr yrleavehome yrleave_14 whichparent, i(IBFLopNrMor IBFLopNrFar) j(sib_n) gen sibID = _n reshape long sibID IBFLopNr sex FoddAr yrleavehome yrleave_14 whichparent sib_n, i(IBFLopNrMor IBFLopNrFar) j(sibID_within) drop if IBFLopNr == . *Keep siblings in right age range sort sibID FoddAr gen age_diff =(FoddAr - FoddAr[_n+1] if sibID == sibID[_n+1]) replace age_diff = abs(age_diff) bysort sibID: egen age_diff_small = min(age_diff) keep if age_diff_small <=3 * Keep families where at least one child leaves home between 1991 and 1993 gen home91_93 = 1 if yrleavehome >=1991 & yrleavehome <= 1993

bysort sibID: egen sibhome91_93 = count(home91_93) keep if sibhome91_93 >= 1 *Keep only siblings who leave home min 4 years apart sort sibID yrleavehome gen leave_diff =(yrleavehome - yrleavehome[_n+1] if sibID == sibID[_n+1]) replace leave_diff = abs(leave_diff) bysort sibID: egen leave_diff_small = min(leave_diff) keep if leave_diff_small <=4 *Keep only pair closest in age gen sibpair = 1 if age_diff == age_diff_small replace sibpair = 1 if age_diff[_n-1] == age_diff_small[_n-1] keep if sibpair == 1 *keep only siblings living with same parent bysort sibID: gen samepar = 1 if whichparent == whichparent[_n+1] replace samepar = 1 if whichparent == whichparent[_n-1] & sibID == sibID[_n-1] *Drop created variables drop sibID_within sib_n age_diff age_diff_small home91_93 sibhome91_93 leave_diff leave_diff_small sibpair samepar *generate sibID different from females(avoid replicas) replace sibID = 1000000+sibID *gen sibling sex variable gen sib_sex == 1 label values sib_sex sib_sex_label save "$path\boys.dta", replace ********************************************************************************** ******Merge boys and girls into one file containing full sibling pair population****************** ********************************************************************************** append using "$path\girls.dta" gen siblingtype = 1 label variable siblingtype "real or random pair" label define sib_label 0 "random pair" 1 "real pair" label values siblingtype sib_label bysort sibID: gen sib_n = _n //*Double check that sib_n = 2! //* Reshape to create new and unique sibIDs for all sibling pairs reshape wide IBFLopNr sex FoddAr yrleavehome yrleave_14 whichparent sib_sex siblingtype, i(sibID) j(sib_n) gen sibID_new = _n drop sibID rename sibID_new = sibID //* Reshape back to long format to add data

reshape long IBFLopNr sex FoddAr yrleavehome yrleave_14 whichparent sib_sex siblingtype sib_n, i(sibID) j(sibID_within) drop whichparent sib_n save "$path\data.dta" ********************************************************************************** ******Add data to chosen individuals******************************************* ********************************************************************************** *Basic ind data merge 1:1 IBFLopNr using "D:\GeoSweden\GeoSweden Stata\Alla register\Basdata\IBF_IndData1990_2014.dta", keepusing(FoddAr sex Fland FlandFar) drop if _merge == 2 drop _merge *Recode country of birth of father gen cob_father = 1 if FlandFar == 1 replace cob_father = 2 if FlandFar >= 2 & FlandFar <= 5 replace cob_father = 3 if FlandFar >= 6 & FlandFar <= 11 replace cob_father = 2 if FlandFar == 12 replace cob_father = 3 if FlandFar >= 13 & FlandFar <= 15 replace cob_father = 2 if FlandFar >= 16 & FlandFar <= 26 replace cob_father = 3 if FlandFar == 27 replace cob_father = 2 if FlandFar == 28 replace cob_father = 3 if FlandFar >= 29 & FlandFar <= 32 replace cob_father = 4 if FlandFar >= 33 & FlandFar <= 52 replace cob_father = 2 if FlandFar == 53 replace cob_father = 4 if FlandFar >= 54 & FlandFar <= 60 replace cob_father = 2 if FlandFar >= 61 & FlandFar <= 62 replace cob_father = 4 if FlandFar >= 63 & FlandFar <= 70 replace cob_father = 2 if FlandFar >= 71 & FlandFar <= 72 replace cob_father = 4 if FlandFar == 73 label variable cob_father "father's country of birth" label define cob_labels 1 "Sweden" 2 "Western countries" 3 "Eastern Europe and Russia" 4 "Africa, Asia, South America" label values cob_father cob_labels drop Fland FlandFar *Calculate age foreach i of numlist 1990 1991 1992 1993 1994 1995 1996 1997 1998 1999 2000 2001 2002 2003 2004 2005 2006 2007 2008 2009 2010{ gen age`i'=`i'-FoddAr } drop FoddAr *Add neighbourhood (sams) foreach i of numlist 1990 1991 1992 1993 1994 1995 1996 1997 1998 1999 2000{ merge 1:1 IBFLopNr using "D:\GeoSweden\GeoSweden Stata\Alla register\Basdata\ibf_bef`i'.dta", keepusing(sams)

merge m:1 IBFLopNr using "D:\GeoSweden\GeoSweden Stata\Alla register\Louise_Lisa\förvärsinkomst_komp\förvärvsinkomst`i'.dta", keepusing(ForvErs) drop if _merge == 2 drop _merge rename ForvErs forvers`i' label variable forvers`i' "income from work`i'" } foreach i of numlist 2005 2006 2007 2008 2009 2010{ merge m:1 IBFLopNr using "D:\GeoSweden\GeoSweden Stata\Alla register\Louise_Lisa\ibf_loua`i'.dta", keepusing(ForvErs) drop if _merge == 2 drop _merge rename ForvErs forvers`i' label variable forvers`i' "income from work`i'" } *Adjust income of work for inflation - 1990 = 1 gen inc_KPI1990 = forvers1990 gen inc_KPI1991 = forvers1991/1.09 gen inc_KPI1992 = forvers1992/1.12 gen inc_KPI1993 = forvers1993/1.17 gen inc_KPI1994 = forvers1994/1.20 gen inc_KPI1995 = forvers1995/1.23 gen inc_KPI1996 = forvers1996/1.23 gen inc_KPI1997 = forvers1997/1.24 gen inc_KPI1998 = forvers1998/1.24 gen inc_KPI1999 = forvers1999/1.24 gen inc_KPI2000 = forvers2000/1.25 gen inc_KPI2001 = forvers2001/1.29 gen inc_KPI2002 = forvers2002/1.31 gen inc_KPI2003 = forvers2003/1.34 gen inc_KPI2004 = forvers2004/1.34 gen inc_KPI2005 = forvers2005/1.35 gen inc_KPI2006 = forvers2006/1.37 gen inc_KPI2007 = forvers2007/1.40 gen inc_KPI2008 = forvers2008/1.45 gen inc_KPI2009 = forvers2009/1.44 gen inc_KPI2010 = forvers2010/1.46 foreach i of numlist 1990 1991 1992 1993 1994 1995 1996 1997 1998 1999 2000 2001 2002 2003 2004 2005 2006 2007 2008 2009 2010{ replace inc_KPI`i' = 0.00001 if inc_KPI`i' == 0 gen ln_inc`i'=ln(inc_KPI`i') drop inc_KPI`i' forvers`i' } **********************************************************************************
**********************************************************************************

//* Add tenure data foreach i of numlist 1990 1991 1992 1993 1994 1995 1996 1997 1998 1999 2000 2001 2002 2003 2004 2005 2006 2007{ merge 1:1 IBFLopNr using "D:\GeoSweden\GeoSweden Stata\Alla register\Fastighet\beffast`i'.dta", keepusing(IBFFastLopNr) drop if _merge == 2 drop _merge rename IBFFastLopNr IBFFastLopNr`i' } foreach i of numlist 2001 2002 2003 2004 2005 2006 2007{ rename IBFFastLopNr`i' IBFFastLopnr merge m:1 IBFFastLopnr using "D:\GeoSweden\GeoSweden Stata\Alla register\Fastighet\fast`i'.dta", keepusing(Typkod JurFormGrp) drop if _merge == 2 drop _merge rename IBFFastLopnr IBFFastLopNr`i' rename Typkod typkod`i' rename JurFormGrp jurformgrp`i' } label define segmentlabels 1 "home ownership" 2 "cooperative" 3 "rental" foreach i of numlist 2000 2001 2002 2003 2004 2005 2006 2007 2008 2009 2010{ gen bostad`i'=0. recode typkod`i' (120/223=1) (320/325=2), gen(hustyp`i') replace bostad`i' = (hustyp`i'*10) + jurformgrp`i' recode bostad`i' (10/13=11) (16=1) (19=1) (17=2) (14/15=3) (18=4) (20/26=5) (29=5) (27=6) (28=7) recode bostad`i' (3=1) (2=2) (6=2) (1=3) (5=3) (4=3) (7=3), gen(tenure`i') label values tenure`i' segmentlabels replace tenure`i' = . if tenure`i' > 4 drop bostad`i' typkod`i' hustyp`i' jurformgrp`i' } save "$path\data.dta", replace **********************************************************************************
**********************************************************************************

****************************************************** ********************************************************************************** ******Slave2_nbd.do ********************************************************************************** //* Create neighbourhood files that identifies share low income earners foreach i of numlist 1990 1991 1992 1993 1994 1995 1996 1997 1998 1999 2000{ use "D:\GeoSweden\GeoSweden Stata\Alla register\Basdata\IBF_IndData1990_2014.dta", keepusing(IBFLopNr FoddAr) gen age`i' = `i'-FoddAr gen workage if age`i' >= 20 & age`i' <= 64 merge 1:1 IBFLopNr using "D:\GeoSweden\GeoSweden Stata\Alla register\Basdata\ibf_bef`i'.dta", keepusing(sams) drop if _merge == 2 drop _merge rename sams sams`i' merge m:1 IBFLopNr using "D:\GeoSweden\GeoSweden Stata\Alla register\Louise_Lisa\förvärsinkomst_komp\förvärvsinkomst`i'.dta", keepusing(ForvErs) drop if _merge == 2 drop _merge rename ForvErs forvers`i' label variable forvers`i' "income from work`i'" egen natdec`i'_low = pctile(forvers`i') if workage == 1, p(30) egen natdec`i'_high = pctile(forvers`i') if workage == 1, p(70) gen lowinc`i' = 1 if forvers`i' < natdec`i'_low & workage == 1 gen highinc`i' = 1 if forvers`i' > natdec`i'_high & workage == 1 collapse (count) inh_2064=IBFLopNr numlow=lowinc`i' numhigh=highinc`i' if workage == 1, by(sams`i') gen sh_low`i' = numlow/inh_2064*100 label variable sh_low`i' "share low income earners" save "$path\sams`i'.dta" } foreach i of numlist 2001 2002 2003 2004{ use "D:\GeoSweden\GeoSweden Stata\Alla register\Basdata\IBF_IndData1990_2014.dta", keepusing(IBFLopNr FoddAr) gen age`i' = `i'-FoddAr gen workage if age`i' >= 20 & age`i' <= 64 merge 1:1 IBFLopNr using "D:\GeoSweden\GeoSweden Stata\Alla register\Basdata\ibf_bef`i'.dta", keepusing(SAMSomrade) drop if _merge == 2

drop _merge rename SAMSomrade sams`i' merge m:1 IBFLopNr using "D:\GeoSweden\GeoSweden Stata\Alla register\Louise_Lisa\förvärsinkomst_komp\förvärvsinkomst`i'.dta", keepusing(ForvErs) drop if _merge == 2 drop _merge rename ForvErs forvers`i' label variable forvers`i' "income from work`i'" egen natdec`i'_low = pctile(forvers`i') if workage == 1, p(30) egen natdec`i'_high = pctile(forvers`i') if workage == 1, p(70) gen lowinc`i' = 1 if forvers`i' < natdec`i'_low & workage == 1 gen highinc`i' = 1 if forvers`i' > natdec`i'_high & workage == 1 collapse (count) inh_2064=IBFLopNr numlow=lowinc`i' numhigh=highinc`i' if workage == 1, by(sams`i') gen sh_low`i' = numlow/inh_2064*100 label variable sh_low`i' "share low income earners" save "$path\sams`i'.dta" } foreach i of numlist 2005 2006 2007 2008 2009 2010{ use "D:\GeoSweden\GeoSweden Stata\Alla register\Basdata\IBF_IndData1990_2014.dta", keepusing(IBFLopNr FoddAr) gen age`i' = `i'-FoddAr gen workage if age`i' >= 20 & age`i' <= 64 merge 1:1 IBFLopNr using "D:\GeoSweden\GeoSweden Stata\Alla register\Basdata\ibf_bef`i'.dta", keepusing(SAMSomrade) drop if _merge == 2 drop _merge rename SAMSomrade sams`i' merge m:1 IBFLopNr using "D:\GeoSweden\GeoSweden Stata\Alla register\Louise_Lisa\ibf_loua`i'.dta", keepusing(ForvErs) drop if _merge == 2 drop _merge rename ForvErs forvers`i' label variable forvers`i' "income from work`i'" egen natdec`i'_low = pctile(forvers`i') if workage == 1, p(30) egen natdec`i'_high = pctile(forvers`i') if workage == 1, p(70) gen lowinc`i' = 1 if forvers`i' < natdec`i'_low & workage == 1 gen highinc`i' = 1 if forvers`i' > natdec`i'_high & workage == 1 collapse (count) inh_2064=IBFLopNr numlow=lowinc`i' numhigh=highinc`i' if workage == 1, by(sams`i') gen sh_low`i' = numlow/inh_2064*100 label variable sh_low`i' "share low income earners" save "$path\sams`i'.dta" }

merge m:1 IBFLopNr using "D:\GeoSweden\GeoSweden Stata\Alla register\Basdata\ibf_bef`i'.dta", keepusing(FamLopNr) drop if _merge == 2 drop _merge rename FamLopNr FamLopNrFar`i' } //* Add income data of father for 1990 merge m:1 IBFLopNr using "D:\GeoSweden\GeoSweden Stata\Alla register\Louise_Lisa\förvärsinkomst_komp\förvärvsinkomst1990.dta", keepusing(ForvErs) drop if _merge == 2 drop _merge rename ForvErs ForvErs90_far label variable ForvErs90_far "father's income from work 1990" rename IBFLopNr IBFLopNrFar rename IBFLopNr_child IBFLopNr *Keep only those who live with parents in 1990 gen livepar = 1 if FamLopNr1990 == FamLopNrMor1990 | FamLopNr == FamLopNrFar1990 keep if livepar == 1 drop livepar *year of leaving parental home - keep only those who move out between 1991 and 1997 gen yrleavehome = . replace yrleavehome = 1991 if FamLopNr1990 == FamLopNrMor1990 | FamLopNr1990 == FamLopNrFar1990 & FamLopNr1990 != . replace yrleavehome = 1992 if FamLopNr1991 == FamLopNrMor1991 | FamLopNr1991 == FamLopNrFar1991 & FamLopNr1991 != . replace yrleavehome = 1993 if FamLopNr1992 == FamLopNrMor1992 | FamLopNr1992 == FamLopNrFar1992 & FamLopNr1992 != . replace yrleavehome = 1994 if FamLopNr1993 == FamLopNrMor1993 | FamLopNr1993 == FamLopNrFar1993 & FamLopNr1993 != . replace yrleavehome = 1995 if FamLopNr1994 == FamLopNrMor1994 | FamLopNr1994 == FamLopNrFar1994 & FamLopNr1994 != . replace yrleavehome = 1996 if FamLopNr1995 == FamLopNrMor1995 | FamLopNr1995 == FamLopNrFar1995 & FamLopNr1995 != . replace yrleavehome = 1997 if FamLopNr1996 == FamLopNrMor1996 | FamLopNr1996 == FamLopNrFar1996 & FamLopNr1996 != . replace yrleavehome = 1998 if FamLopNr1997 == FamLopNrMor1997 | FamLopNr1997 == FamLopNrFar1997 & FamLopNr1997 != . replace yrleavehome = . if yrleavehome == 1998 & FamLopNr1997 == . replace yrleavehome = . if FamLopNr1990 == . & FamLopNr1991 == . & FamLopNr1992 == . & FamLopNr1993 == . & FamLopNr1994 == . & FamLopNr1995 == . & FamLopNr1996 == . & FamLopNr1997 == . label variable yrleavehome "first year living away from parents" keep if yrleavehome >= 1991 & yrleavehome <= 1997 gen yrleave_14 = yrleavehome+13 label variable ylrleave_14 "year 14 years after having left parental home" save "$path\random.dta"

//* Create income categories of father's income - using cutpoint identified in nbd data file cut points income from national income distribution (identified when running nbd data) gen inc_fa = 1 if ForvErs90_far < 878 replace inc_fa = 2 if ForvErs90_far >= 878 & ForvErs90_far < 1610 replace inc_fa = 3 if ForvErs90_far >= 1610 label variable inc_fa "income level of father" label define inc_lab 1 "low inc" 2 "mid inc" 3 "high inc" label values inc_fa inc_lab drop ForvErs90_far //* Country of birth of father gen cob_father = 1 if FlandFar == 1 replace cob_father = 2 if FlandFar >= 2 & FlandFar <= 5 replace cob_father = 3 if FlandFar >= 6 & FlandFar <= 11 replace cob_father = 2 if FlandFar == 12 replace cob_father = 3 if FlandFar >= 13 & FlandFar <= 15 replace cob_father = 2 if FlandFar >= 16 & FlandFar <= 26 replace cob_father = 3 if FlandFar == 27 replace cob_father = 2 if FlandFar == 28 replace cob_father = 3 if FlandFar >= 29 & FlandFar <= 32 replace cob_father = 4 if FlandFar >= 33 & FlandFar <= 52 replace cob_father = 2 if FlandFar == 53 replace cob_father = 4 if FlandFar >= 54 & FlandFar <= 60 replace cob_father = 2 if FlandFar >= 61 & FlandFar <= 62 replace cob_father = 4 if FlandFar >= 63 & FlandFar <= 70 replace cob_father = 2 if FlandFar >= 71 & FlandFar <= 72 replace cob_father = 4 if FlandFar == 73 label variable cob_father "father's country of birth" label values cob_father cob_labels drop FlandFar Fland ********************************************************************************** ******Create random sibling pairs****************************************************** ********************************************************************************** generate random = runiform() sort sams90 sex cob_father inc_fa random by sams90 sex cob_father inc_fa: gen case_no = _n by sams90 sex cob_father inc_fa: egen mean = mean(case_no) gen sibno = 1 if case_no > mean replace sibno = 2 if case_no <= mean gen no1
